blocks.heading: Glue components

items.name: Job bookmarks
items.text: Tracks S3 timestamps or monotonic JDBC keys to read only new data. Enable flag, set transformation_ctx, call job.init() & commit().

items.name: Multi-source ETL
items.text: Joins JDBC (Aurora/RDS) & S3 catalog tables, writes Parquet/Iceberg, updates catalog. Author visually in Glue Studio (editable PySpark).

items.name: Streaming ETL
items.text: Reads Kinesis, MSK, or Kafka in micro-batches to S3/catalog. Use Managed Service for Apache Flink for sub-second or stateful logic.

blocks.heading: Exam tips & traps
items: Bookmark job reprocessing everything -> missing transformation_ctx or job.commit().
Private VPC timeout -> missing S3 gateway endpoint or self-referencing SG rule.
Python shell is single-process (not for TB); Spark has startup overhead -> use Lambda for tiny tasks.
Never hardcode DB passwords in job scripts -> store in Secrets Manager and reference in the connection.

blocks.heading: Job types
rows: Large batch ETL, joins, format conversion

Billed per DPU-hour (short min); avoid idle
